beats.say: Strong technical rounds get you to the bar.
beats.text: Technical gets you to the bar

beats.say: The behavioral round decides the level. Offers are lost here more than in coding.
beats.label: Then
beats.head: Behavioral decides the level

beats.say: Three tools: the STAR shape, a story bank, and the right scope.
beats.label: Track 18 · Behavioral

check.prompt: Which part of a STAR answer should be the longest?
check.why: The action is your work. It is the evidence the interviewer writes down.

beats.say: First: tell every story in one shape.
Situation. Task. Action. Result. In about two minutes.
beats.label: STAR

beats.say: Spend most of the time on the action. That is your work.
beats.label: Where the time goes
beats.head: Most time on the action

beats.say: And say I, not we. The interviewer scores you, not your team.
beats.label: One word
beats.head: Say I, not we

beats.say: End with a result that has a number.
beats.label: The ending
beats.head: A result with a number

beats.say: Second: do not invent stories in the room.
Prepare about 8 true stories before the loop.
Each story can answer several questions. A conflict story also shows influence.
beats.label: Reuse
beats.head: One story, many questions

options: I fixed the bug I was given
I found the problem, aligned two teams, and fixed it
check.why: Senior scope is more than your own task: you found the problem and moved other people.

beats.say: Third: match the scope to the level.
A mid-level story: I did the task I was given, and I did it well.
beats.label: Mid-level
beats.head: I did my task well

beats.say: A senior story: I found the problem, and I moved other teams to fix it.
beats.label: Senior
beats.head: I found it and moved others

beats.say: Last: tell me about a failure.
Pick a real failure. Own your part. Do not blame other people.
beats.label: Be honest
beats.head: A real failure, owned

beats.say: Then say what you changed after it. That change is the answer.
beats.label: The point
beats.head: What you changed after

beats.say: Quick recap of the behavioral round.
Use the STAR shape. Prepare eight stories. And show scope beyond your own task.
beats.label: Behavioral

beats.say: Now start the first lesson below.
